research_question: For identical workloads and pair-matched memory capacities, how does capacity-safe admission compare with native SGLang in GPU-resident, CPU-tiered, and storage-tiered modes?
limitations: This compares complete policies, not admission logic in isolation.
Capacity-safe restores and verifies lower-tier KV before backend submission.
File-backed storage may be served by the operating-system page cache.
Synthetic equal-priority coding sessions use fixed tool waits.
